title: Waypoint Volunteer
eyebrow: Waypoint Studio · What good can I do today?
lead: A hopeful discovery platform with Opportunity Intelligence — prioritized, explained suggestions that adapt to weather, time, and private preferences. Not volunteer management, not registration, not social media.
mission: Anyone who wants a calm answer to “What good can I do today?” — neighbors, families, outdoor people, and careful observers looking for a place to help without pressure, rankings, or gamification.
problems: Good opportunities are scattered across calendars and websites
People want short, local, or outdoor ways to help — not another admin portal
Recommendations should respect season, weather, skills, and available time

cta.label: What good can I do today?

capabilityGroups.title: Opportunity Intelligence
capabilityGroups.description: Soft private scores with plain-language reasons — weather, season, distance, accessibility, and causes.

capabilityGroups.title: Kinds of good work
capabilityGroups.description: Discovery covers community and outdoor stewardship — samples today, curated sources later.

principles: Curiosity and stewardship — never rankings, streaks, or likes
Sample data stays labeled sample until curated sources exist
Contact organizations directly — Waypoint does not RSVP for you
Profile, saves, and impact stay private on-device

privacyPhilosophy: Sample organizations and opportunities ship in design-system/volunteer/. Profile, planning, and impact use localStorage only. No backend. No public activity feed. You contact organizations yourself.
futureDirection: Richer live catalogs and Dashboard Today Outside glances — still discovery-only, still without gamification.
